description: Run a data transformation script and validate output correctness. Navigate to /home/ga/workspace/data_validation/ directory. Open the integrated terminal (Ctrl+`) and run the command: python parse_orders.py sample_input.csv actual_output.csv. This will transform the input CSV. Then, use VSCode's diff viewer to compare the generated actual_output.csv with expected_output.csv (right-click on actual_output.csv and select 'Select for Compare', then right-click on expected_output.csv and select 'Compare with Selected'). After verifying the files match, create a file named validation_passed.txt in the same directory containing the exact text: Output matches expected result
